depicted_variant: Giant serpent of the Miyazaki protective legend, rising above a pond.

visual_requirements.description: One giant limbless snake, one head and two eyes; no horns or invented divine anatomy.
Pond and waterfall associated with worship.

aura: Awe comes from the giant protective serpent of c03 and its pond setting c02, without invented magic.
artistic_choices: Respectful majestic protective treatment, no monstrous demonization.
No documented visible power; physical water displacement is ordinary consequence of giant snake movement, not water control.
Low camera, close head and wet scales, dark walnut palette and moon rim light are editorial choices.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Jaō Gongen, a Japanese serpent deity, shown as the giant protective snake of the Miyazaki legend.
ANATOMY: exactly one giant snake head, two natural eyes, long thick limbless body with wet dark bronze scales; no horns, fins, wings, legs, jewelry or humanoid features. [jao-gongen-c01, jao-gongen-c03]
MOMENT: rise above the viewer, curving the huge neck protectively across the foreground, head looking sharply down toward camera; body pushes pond water aside.
POWER: no documented visible power; awe through giant anatomy, moving mass and light only. Protective presence [jao-gongen-c03].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle at waterline; head and thick neck fill most of frame; tiny pond rocks and waterfall behind establish documented giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant shaft of moonlight, sharp rim light, deep warm shadows, natural waterfall spray.
SURFACE: rough individually readable wet scales, weathered stone, turbulent dark water.
SETTING: a Japanese woodland pond below a waterfall [jao-gongen-c02].
MOOD: sacred, protective, awe-inspiring and overwhelming, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoinscriptions, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads or limbs; no borrowed film, game, anime or comic design; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, magic symbols.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Inspected native PNG and 200px thumbnail: giant one-headed limbless serpent dominates, rising action is readable, pond spray is physical water displacement, no unsupported magic, no text or borrowed design; all seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Giant snake rising from the pond under the falls at night.
